title: package.json is not valid JSON
msg: package.json does not parse as JSON, so vsce reads nothing and every other check below is blind.
fix: Fix the JSON syntax first (trailing comma, unquoted key, stray comment).

title: engines.vscode is missing
msg: No engines.vscode field. vsce refuses to package a manifest without it, and the Marketplace has no idea which VS Code builds may install you.
fix: Add "engines": { "vscode": "^1.90.0" } using the oldest VS Code you actually support.

title: engines.vscode is "*"
msg: engines.vscode is a wildcard. vsce rejects "*" — it needs a concrete minimum such as ^1.90.0.
fix: Replace "*" with the caret range of the oldest VS Code API you call.

title: @types/vscode is newer than engines.vscode
msg: devDependencies["@types/vscode"] declares a newer VS Code than engines.vscode allows. You compile against API that your declared minimum build does not have, and vsce stops the package step.
fix: Raise engines.vscode to match @types/vscode, or pin @types/vscode down to engines.vscode.

title: publisher is missing
msg: No publisher field. The extension id is publisher.name — without it there is no id, so packaging and publishing both stop.
fix: Add "publisher": "<your marketplace publisher id>" (the same id on Open VSX becomes your namespace).

title: name is not a valid extension id segment
msg: name must be lowercase with no spaces — only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. Anything else cannot become half of a publisher.name id.
fix: Lowercase the name and replace spaces and dots with hyphens. displayName is where the pretty title goes.

title: version is not plain x.y.z
msg: The Marketplace accepts only three numeric parts. A four-part version or a -beta suffix is refused at upload, after your build has already run.
fix: Use a plain 1.2.3. Ship pre-releases with the --pre-release flag instead of a version suffix.

title: categories contains a name that is not on the list
msg: categories is a closed vocabulary. A category that is not on the list fails validation, and a near-miss like "Linter" or "Theme" is the usual cause.
fix: Use exact names from the allowed list, e.g. Linters, Themes, Programming Languages, Snippets, Formatters.

title: badges points at a host that is not approved
msg: Badge images are restricted to an approved host list. A badge from anywhere else is rejected rather than silently dropped.
fix: Serve the badge through img.shields.io, or drop the badges field and put the image in README.md instead.

title: no main and no contributes
msg: Nothing declares any code or any contribution, so the extension installs and then does nothing at all. This ships without an error.
fix: Add "main": "./extension.js" for code, or a contributes block for a declarative extension.

title: repository is missing
msg: Without repository, relative image and link paths in README.md have no base to be rewritten against, and your Open VSX namespace cannot be tied back to a source.
fix: Add "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git" } with an https URL, not an SSH one.

title: license field is missing
msg: No license field, so the listing page shows no licence to anyone deciding whether their company may install this.
fix: Add "license": "MIT" (an SPDX id) and keep the matching LICENSE file in the package.

title: icon is missing
msg: No icon field, so your tile renders as the grey default next to every competitor that shipped one.
fix: Add "icon": "images/icon.png", 128x128 PNG, and make sure .vscodeignore does not exclude it.

title: activationEvents contains "*"
msg: "*" activates your extension during every window startup, whether or not the user is doing anything you handle. It is the single biggest startup-cost flag reviewers look for.
fix: Replace "*" with the events you really need: onLanguage:, onCommand:, workspaceContains:, onStartupFinished.

title: onCommand entry duplicates a contributed command
msg: This onCommand activation event repeats a command already declared in contributes.commands. Modern VS Code generates that activation for you, so the line is dead weight kept in sync by hand.
fix: Delete the duplicated onCommand entry and let contributes.commands imply it.

title: description is longer than 200 characters
msg: The short description is cut off in search results and on the tile, so the end of your sentence is never read by anyone browsing.
fix: Cut the description to 200 characters or fewer and move the detail into README.md.
